title: MobileProbe: Adaptive Security Evaluation of Mobile Agents via Trajectory-Aware Injection
abstract: arXiv:2611.16693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents read the screen of a phone and operate apps on a user's behalf to complete multi-step tasks such as online shopping or messaging. Because the agent acts on whatever the screen shows, an attacker can embed malicious instructions into ordinary UI content and redirect its actions. We refer to this threat as environmental injection attack (EIA). Existing benchmarks measure this risk by pinning hand-crafted payloads to a fixed step of a fixed task. This approach faces two limitations. First, each payload is bound to one task in one app and does not transfer without manual redesign. Second, agents given the same task may follow different routes, so an agent that never reaches the injected page is recorded as safe without being tested. translated_title: MobileProbe：基于轨迹感知注入的移动智能体自适应安全评估
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体通过读取手机屏幕内容并代表用户操作应用，来完成诸如在线购物或发送消息等多步骤任务。由于智能体会对屏幕上显示的任何内容采取行动，攻击者可以将恶意指令嵌入普通UI内容中并劫持其行为，我们将这种威胁称为环境注入攻击（EIA）。现有基准测试通过将手工制作的攻击载荷固定在特定任务的特定步骤上来衡量这种风险，该方法存在两个局限：首先，每个攻击载荷绑定于单一应用中的单个任务，若不进行人工重新设计则无法迁移；其次，执行相同任务的智能体可能采取不同路径，因此从未到达被注入页面的智能体会在未经实际测试的情况下被记录为安全。这种测试覆盖不足可能导致定点基准测试低估已部署移动智能体的安全风险。在本工作中，我们提出了MobileProbe，一种轨迹感知的红队……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出MobileProbe，一种基于轨迹感知的自适应安全评估方法，通过根据移动智能体的实际执行轨迹动态注入环境攻击载荷，解决了现有定点基准测试中攻击载荷难以迁移、测试覆盖不足从而低估安全风险的问题。
en_tdlr: MobileProbe is a trajectory-aware adaptive security evaluation framework that dynamically injects environmental injection attack payloads along mobile agents' actual execution trajectories, addressing the payload transferability and insufficient test coverage limitations of existing fixed-point benchmarks.
